```plato

    // Eberly's refinement. The corner the ray reached is visible unless a reflex
    // vertex of the ring lies in the wedge between the ray and that corner; among
    // those that do, the bridge goes to the one whose direction from the hole makes
    // the smallest angle with the ray, ties going to the rightmost.
    VisibleSlot(points: Array<Point2D>, nodes: Buffer<EarClipNode>, head: Integer,
        seed: Integer, holeSlot: Integer, rayX: Number): Integer
    {
        var hole = points.NodePoint(nodes, holeSlot);
        var corner = points.NodePoint(nodes, seed);
        var wedgeNear = Point2D(hole.Y < corner.Y ? hole.X : rayX, hole.Y);
        var wedgeFar = Point2D(hole.Y < corner.Y ? rayX : hole.X, hole.Y);
        var wedge = Triangle2D(wedgeNear, corner, wedgeFar);
        var best = seed;
        var bestTangent = Number.MaxValue;
        var slot = head;
        var stepped = false;
        while (stepped.Not || slot != head)
        {
            stepped = true;
            var c = points.NodePoint(nodes, slot);
            if (hole.X >= c.X && c.X >= corner.X && hole.X != c.X && wedge.Contains(c))
            {
                var tangent = (hole.Y - c.Y).Abs / (hole.X - c.X);
                if (points.LocallyInside(nodes, slot, holeSlot)
                    && (tangent < bestTangent
                        || (tangent == bestTangent
                            && c.X > points.NodePoint(nodes, best).X)))
                {
                    best = slot;
                    bestTangent = tangent;
                }
            }
            slot = nodes.At(slot).Next;
        }
        return best;
    }
```
